name: stratum

engines.//: node:sqlite is unflagged only from 22.13.0; tests/helpers/sqlite-d1.ts imports it.

description: A code collaboration platform for the AI engineering era, built on Cloudflare Workers.

ARTIFACTS.description: Cloudflare **Artifacts** (private beta) stores every Stratum repository. Stratum will not start a forge project without it — request access before deploying.

DB.description: D1 database for changes, issues, events, audit and cost records. Schema is applied by the deploy command (`wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote`).

STATE.description: KV namespace holding project/workspace identity and session state.

BACKUPS.description: R2 bucket for nightly D1 dumps and repo packs. Backups no-op if this is unbound.

AI.description: Workers AI, used by the `llm` evaluator. Naming `llm` in `merge.requiredEvaluators` without this binding blocks every merge in that project.

OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI.description: Set to `https://<your-worker-url>/auth/github/callback` after the first deploy, and register the same URL in your GitHub OAuth app.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: GitHub OAuth app client ID — create one at [github.com/settings/developers](https://github.com/settings/developers). Leave blank to use email magic links instead.

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret for the same GitHub OAuth app.

EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS.description: Sender for magic-link emails, e.g. `noreply@yourdomain.com`. Requires `wrangler email sending enable yourdomain.com` on a domain in this account.

ADMIN_API_KEY.description: Sent as the `X-Admin-API-Key` header to reach `/api/admin/*` (backups, restore, audit, metrics). Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Without this or `ADMIN_EMAIL` the admin surface is unreachable.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: A signed-in user with this email address is treated as an admin. An alternative to `ADMIN_API_KEY`.

DEPLOY_SECRET_KEY.description: Master key encrypting per-project deploy secrets. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`; rotating it makes every stored secret undecryptable.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Required for promote-to-PR and for reporting eval verdicts to GitHub; also raises repo import rate limits.
